title: Addition and Subtraction of Whole Numbers
seo_title: Addition and Subtraction – Primary 4 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Add and subtract whole numbers in thousands, hundreds, tens and units, with and without regrouping; solve word problems. (summary of the NERDC Primary 4 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 4 maths worksheets on adding and subtracting whole numbers in thousands, hundreds, tens and units, with and without regrouping, subtracting across zeros and word problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Carry and borrow 10 to the next place.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Write the numbers under each other: units under units, tens under tens, and so on.
  • Start from the units. When a column adds up to 10 or more, carry 1 to the next column.
  • In subtraction, if the top digit is smaller, borrow 1 from the next place (it becomes 10 in this place).
  • Check a subtraction by adding: difference + smaller number = bigger number.

Examples

Example

3,486 + 2,759

6 + 9 = 15, write 5 carry 1

…

Answer: 6,245

Example

5,003 − 1,428

Borrow across the zeros

Answer: 3,575

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Not lining up the placesUnits under units, tens under tens.
Forgetting the carried 1Write it above the next column.
Subtracting the smaller digit from the bigger in every columnBorrow when the top digit is smaller.

faq.a: Changing 10 units into 1 ten (carrying) or 1 ten into 10 units (borrowing).

faq.q: How do I check my subtraction?
faq.a: Add the answer to the number you took away. You should get the first number.
Altogether, sum, total, more than, increase.
